detail.problem: Two issues. (1) 'Previous/current tooth pain': only a current 'Toothache' is matched; a patient whose tooth pain has settled but who now has pus/swelling would not satisfy the rule. SNOMED has the qualifier value 'Previous' (and 'In the past'), so (or Toothache (Toothache qualifier Previous)) was expressible and would need its own check_for entry. (2) Logic: the page reads 'tooth pain with pus in mouth, swelling next to tooth'. The rule requires toothache AND pus AND swelling. The comma list is ambiguous; the more clinically natural reading is tooth pain with either sign (an abscess that has not pointed shows swelling without visible pus).
